# particles2SNR SNR And Noise Report

## Summary

- Same filtered-noise model supported: `False`
- Class SNR difference supported: `True`
- SNR method note: Current SNR is per detected particle but uses a per-file lowest-window noise floor. It is useful for ranking events within/across files; if filtered_std differs significantly by class, report class-aware noise normalization alongside the per-particle SNR.
